description: Typed UI<->controller contract for the WinUI 3 Control Room. Every command and query is versioned; the compiled CommandNames()/QueryNames() lists must agree with this registry (drift check in tests/contract/registry_tests.cpp).

commands.name: OpenFolder
commands.note: Validates and binds (or restores) project identity for a user-chosen folder. Never scans, launches agents or touches Git.

commands.name: SendMessage
commands.note: Persists exactly one immutable UserContribution after a root is bound, even with no CLI available; agent work is gated separately.

commands.name: CancelOperation
commands.note: Cancels the session behind a timeline operation; the observed termination is reported separately.

commands.name: RetryAgentProbe
commands.note: Bounded, non-mutating readiness re-probe for one agent.

commands.name: DismissCard
commands.note: Hides a dismissible timeline card without deleting history.

commands.name: SetAgentExecutablePath
commands.note: Stores the user-owned executable path and re-probes. Never a model/provider flag.

commands.name: RequestDetails
commands.note: Builds the inspectable details for one card from the backing authoritative records.

queries.name: QueryProjectState
queries.note: Bound flag, identity, canonical root, phase and epoch.

queries.name: QueryTimeline
queries.note: Bounded, ordered page of Chat timeline items since a sequence.

queries.name: QueryAgents
queries.note: All three agents with readiness; only non-READY ones need attention.
